sections.content: The staged adapter records immutable hash-bound RED, implementation, GREEN, and refactor evidence. RED stops at implementation, and later stages consume matching predecessor lineage.
sections.title: Lifecycle behavior

sections.content: Routing derives the next stage from persisted evidence, supports recovery without stage state, and treats implementation as a successor. Legacy evidence is read-only after staged cutover.
sections.title: Recovery and migration

sections.content: Three slices cover stage evidence, recovery routing, and migration dogfood. Registered commands run focused tests, adapter tests, staged dogfood, and terminal validation.
sections.title: Validation contract
